Muscle powers every movement an animal makes — from the molecular motors inside a single fiber to the coordinated mechanics of running, balancing, and recovering from a stumble. This curriculum brings the science to you directly from the researchers doing it: expert-led workshop recordings, curated learning pathways, and open-access resources. Browse freely, or let a pathway guide you.
